entities.name: Kydele
entities.description: Legendary human wizard of Theros, Chosen of Kruphix and the primary oracle to Kruphix in Meletis.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: Theros's enigmatic god of horizons and mysteries.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Satyr whose ascension and fall Kydele witnessed.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who betrayed his champion Elspeth.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Realm whose nature Kydele began to question.

events.summary: In danger, Kydele is spirited away by Kruphix himself.
events.quote: she was spirited away by Kruphix himself

events.summary: Kruphix reveals that the gods did not create mortals but are products of mortal belief and faith.
events.quote: the gods were products of mortal belief and faith

events.summary: Kruphix tells Kydele of many worlds and menaces beyond the gods like the Eldrazi, Nicol Bolas and New Phyrexia.
events.quote: there are menaces so great that even the gods couldn't be able to defeat them

events.summary: Kydele returns to Meletis and keeps the knowledge to herself.
events.quote: decided to keep this new knowledge for herself

relations.quote: Kydele serves as the primary oracle to Kruphix
